description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), grants [Awoken Height of Evil Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Holy, Dark)] and [Monochrome Syndrome] to the user

description.name: Awoken Height of Evil Mode
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Delta Storm after using a Holy or Dark ability

description.name: Delta Storm
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (2.41 or 2.45), [Buff Holy 10% (15s)] and [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Buff Holy 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Monochrome Syndrome
description.text: Grants [Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] to user after using two Holy or Dark Abilities

description.name: Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 30% more damage
